newsitem.title: TURKEY: 17 Iraqis die, five missing trying to reach Greece.
newsitem.headline: 17 Iraqis die, five missing trying to reach Greece.

text.p: At least 17 Iraqi illegal immigrants drowned in the Aegean Sea when two boats smuggling them from Turkey to a Greek island collided, Anatolian news agency said on Monday.
It said another five people were missing after Sunday's accident in the sea between the western Turkish tourist resort of Kusadasi and the island of Samos.
Eleven of the dead were from the same family of ethnic Turcomans, it said.
Iraqi illegal immigrants often try to make it from Turkey to Greece in flimsy boats and then on to western Europe.
